none: PAS LON-A5D591: Roman copper alloy coin: nummus from the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Greater London (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman copper alloy coin: nummus from the House of Constantine dated AD330-335. Reverse: Victory on prow. Trier mint. Reece period 17. Obverse: Helmetted bust left. Obverse inscription: [CONS]TAN[TINOPOLIS]. Reverse: Victory on prow with sceptre and shield, symbol of the new Constantinople, New Rome. Reverse inscription: None. Mint mark: -/-//TRP. Die axis measurement: 1.00. Dimensions: diameter: 14.58mm; weight: 1.23g
